name: feed
description: ArcaFeed, RuliFeed 및 공용 @feed/core 통합 개발 환경

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ArcaFeed ci && npm --prefix RuliFeed ci
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.dev: npm run dev:arca && npm run dev:ruli
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:arca && npm run build:ruli
scripts.lint: npm run lint:core && npm run lint:arca && npm run lint:ruli
scripts.format: npm run format:root && npm run format:core && npm run format:arca && npm run format:ruli
scripts.format:root: node ArcaFeed/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config prettier.config.js --write README.md AGENTS.md package.json prettier.config.js eslint.config.js webpack.config.js "docs/**/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:root && npm run format:check:core && npm run format:check:arca && npm run format:check:ruli
scripts.format:check:root: node ArcaFeed/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --config prettier.config.js --check README.md AGENTS.md package.json prettier.config.js eslint.config.js webpack.config.js "docs/**/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:arca && npm run typecheck:ruli
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:arca && npm run test:ruli
scripts.test:architecture: npm --prefix ArcaFeed run test:architecture && npm --prefix RuliFeed run test:architecture
scripts.test:performance: npm --prefix ArcaFeed run test:performance && npm --prefix RuliFeed run test:performance
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Roharui
